data.problem: Need a clear, actionable picture of how opencode selects models, configures providers, and sets model parameters (including any verbosity/reasoning controls).
constraints: Explore phase only: no code or implementation artifacts
Prefer fastest learning loops over exhaustive analysis

options.name: Trace the model pipeline end-to-end
options.approach: Summarize the flow from config → Provider.state → getSDK/getLanguage → LLM.stream → provider request payload with a concrete example model.
options.what_we_learn: Exact precedence rules and where parameters land in the request body.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low — uses existing code paths only.

options.name: Config surface area matrix
options.approach: List all configurable fields (config + CLI + env) and map them to provider options and model parameters, including reasoning/verbosity controls.
options.what_we_learn: Which knobs are user-tweakable vs. hardcoded defaults.

options.name: Provider-specific deep dives
options.approach: Pick 2-3 providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google) and document their custom loaders, env vars, and parameter quirks.
options.what_we_learn: Provider-specific constraints and likely configuration pitfalls.

data.recommendation: Option 1 — fastest way to validate the actual parameter flow and model selection precedence before expanding into a config matrix.
